title: NexusDaemonCheckRequest
description: POST /v1/daemon/check — run spoke orchestrate_check over an owned World (V1.148 P2).

world_id.description: World ownership key; must match active creator ownership (is_world_owned).

scope.description: Spoke Scope selector (scope_id should equal world_id). Mirrors spoke ops CheckRequest.scope fields needed by codegen.

rule_refs.description: Opaque rule ids resolved via RuleQueryPort (P1).

rules.description: Optional embedded spoke Rule objects (portable interchange). Prefer $ref to spoke rule schema if monorepo codegen supports external $ref; else opaque object validated when mapped to spoke Rule.
